notes: Only assigned unfinished original fields examined. Other fields are unassigned null placeholders. PDF pp. 16–17 inspected for layout, metric symbols and signs; evidence quotes retain canonical text. Description calls consumption resources earned versus unearned without specifying fairness or whether the target is marginal. The reported omnibus resource effect has three levels: F(2,245)=3.85, printed eta-squared .029. Separate earned/unearned simple comparisons are reported under salient fairness (t=2.87, d=-0.58 in PDF) and neutral fairness (t=0.56, d=0.14). The three-level omnibus cannot be silently substituted for a two-level marginal contrast.
